title: PurchaseRow uses non-existent translation key 'langCode'
body: In PurchasesPageContent.tsx line 78: `const localeDir = locale('langCode') === 'he' ? 'he' : 'en'`. The `langCode` key doesn't exist in `auth.account` translations, so `locale('langCode')` always returns the raw key `"langCode"`, making `localeDir` always `'en'`. This differs from `TransactionDetailContent` which hardcodes `'he'`. Either add `langCode` to translations or use the correct locale source.
rationale: Inconsistent locale handling between list and detail pages - dates may format differently on each page.

title: RefundInfo hardcodes Hebrew locale for date formatting
body: In TransactionDetailContent.tsx line 203: `formatDate(refundedAt, 'he')` hardcodes Hebrew locale regardless of user preference. Should use the user's actual locale from context.
rationale: Users with English locale would see Hebrew date formatting, which is inconsistent with rest of app.
